data-dirty.description: Present when the number field's value has changed (when wrapped in Field.Root).

data-disabled.description: Present when the number field is disabled.

data-filled.description: Present when the number field is filled (when wrapped in Field.Root).

data-focused.description: Present when the number field is focused (when wrapped in Field.Root).

data-invalid.description: Present when the number field is in invalid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

data-readonly.description: Present when the number field is readonly.

data-required.description: Present when the number field is required.

data-touched.description: Present when the number field has been touched (when wrapped in Field.Root).

data-valid.description: Present when the number field is in valid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

description:
Groups all parts of the number field and manages its state.
Renders a `<div>` element.
name: NumberFieldRoot

allowOutOfRange.description:
When true, direct text entry may be outside the `min`/`max` range without clamping,
so native range underflow/overflow validation can occur.
Step-based interactions (keyboard arrows, buttons, wheel, scrub) still clamp.

allowWheelScrub.description:
Whether to allow the user to scrub the input value with the mouse wheel while focused and
hovering over the input.

className.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component’s state.

defaultValue.description:
The uncontrolled value of the field when it’s initially rendered.

To render a controlled number field, use the `value` prop instead.

disabled.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

format.description: Options to format the input value.

id.description: The id of the input element.

inputRef.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

largeStep.description:
The large step value of the input element when incrementing while the shift key is held. Snaps
to multiples of this value.

locale.description:
The locale of the input element.
Defaults to the user's runtime locale.

max.description: The maximum value of the input element.

min.description: The minimum value of the input element.

name.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

onValueChange.description:
Callback fired when the number value changes.

The `eventDetails.reason` indicates what triggered the change:
- `'input-change'` for parseable typing or programmatic text updates
- `'input-clear'` when the field becomes empty
- `'input-blur'` when formatting (and clamping, if enabled) occurs on blur
- `'input-paste'` for paste interactions
- `'keyboard'` for keyboard input
- `'increment-press'` / `'decrement-press'` for button presses on the increment and decrement controls
- `'wheel'` for wheel-based scrubbing
- `'scrub'` for scrub area drags
onValueChange.detailedType:
| ((
    value: number | null,
    eventDetails: NumberField.Root.ChangeEventDetails,
  ) => void)
| undefined

onValueCommitted.description:
Callback function that is fired when the value is committed.
It runs later than `onValueChange`, when:
- The input is blurred after typing a value.
- The pointer is released after scrubbing or pressing the increment/decrement buttons.

It runs simultaneously with `onValueChange` when interacting with the keyboard.

**Warning**: This is a generic event not a change event.
onValueCommitted.detailedType:
| ((
    value: number | null,
    eventDetails: NumberField.Root.CommitEventDetails,
  ) => void)
| undefined

readOnly.description: Whether the user should be unable to change the field value.

render.description:
Allows you to replace the component’s HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
render.detailedType:
| ReactElement
| ((
    props: HTMLProps,
    state: NumberField.Root.State,
  ) => ReactElement)

required.description: Whether the user must enter a value before submitting a form.

smallStep.description:
The small step value of the input element when incrementing while the meta key is held. Snaps
to multiples of this value.

snapOnStep.description: Whether the value should snap to the nearest step when incrementing or decrementing.

step.description:
Amount to increment and decrement with the buttons and arrow keys, or to scrub with pointer movement in the scrub area.
To always enable step validation on form submission, specify the `min` prop explicitly in conjunction with this prop.
Specify `step="any"` to always disable step validation.

| React.CSSProperties
| ((

| undefined

value.description: The raw numeric value of the field.
